issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: dandelion, azure_bluet, allium, cornflower, oxeye_daisy, fern, oak_hanging_sign, candle, red_wall_banner.
504 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.roof: False alarm on the automatic 'roof has no overhang' warning: the eaves overhang the walls by 1 block on all four sides (x3/x11 at y4, z1/z13 gables); the beer-garden terrace, planters and props stand outside the eaves and confuse the check.
notes.life: Bushes, flower beds and planters along the east side, flowers at the front plinth, candles and a terrace lantern.
notes.grandeur: A pleasant, lively tavern; not a landmark, which is right for its role.

visual.summary: L2 plus a beer-garden terrace of tables and benches with a hedge on the east side, flower planters and flowers round the base, candles inside and more kegs by the kitchen.
problems: Coarse-dirt planters at x11 y0 z3-4 and x11 y0 z7 have a trapdoor only on the east face; their north/south ends (z2/z5 side of z3-4, z6 side of z7) show bare dirt: close them with spruce trapdoors.
Chimney top with the campfire (x7 y8 z13) is level with the ridge: raise it one block.
Flowers, candle, oak_hanging_sign and red_wall_banner are not yet builder-tested (automatic info).
Reach: 160 of 267 reached; unreached are roof slopes, ridge and chimney-side tops only, floor, kitchen and terrace reached: fine.

issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: dandelion, azure_bluet, allium, cornflower, oxeye_daisy, fern, oak_hanging_sign, candle, brick_slab, red_wall_banner, brick_wall.
564 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.levels: Adds two clearly visible new functions over L2: a brick bread oven (furnace mouth, own little brick-wall flue) opening into the outdoor kitchen, and a storeroom shed (barrels, chest) behind a beer-garden terrace with two tables and benches (extra dining). Reads apart from L2 at a glance.
notes.roof: Main roof good (overhang all round; the automatic warning is a false alarm; chimney reaches the ridge). The new storeroom shed (x0-2 z11-14) has a flat spruce-slab roof at y2: it reads as a crate lid next to the steep hall roof.
notes.life: Flower boxes now closed with trapdoors on every end (x11 z2/z5/z6/z8): v1 bare-dirt ends fixed. Hedges, flowers and lanterns along the terrace.

visual.summary: L3 adds a bread oven next to the outdoor kitchen, a storeroom shed and a beer-garden terrace with extra tables, plus candles and flower boxes, on top of the L2 hall and kitchen.
problems: Storeroom shed (x0-2 y2 z11-14) has a flat slab roof: give it a small pitched or lean-to stair roof (stairs sloping away from the hall) so it matches the main roof.
Flowers, candle, brick_slab, brick_wall, oak_hanging_sign and red_wall_banner are not yet builder-tested (automatic info).

Reach: 146 of 272 standing places reached; the unreached ones are main roof slopes, the ridge, the lean-to roof, the oven top (brick slabs x11-12 y3 z13-14), the shed's slab roof (x0-2 y3 z11-14) and the two chimney-side brick tops at y4 z13; the whole floor, kitchen, terrace, shed and outdoor kitchen are reached: fine.
